summary.plain: The international team, led by the Max Planck Institute for Nuclear Physics in Heidelberg, that ran the GALLEX and GNO gallium solar-neutrino experiments in Italy.
summary.technical: International collaboration (France, Germany, Italy, Israel, Poland, US) led by MPIK Heidelberg, operating GALLEX (1991-1997) and its successor GNO (1998-2003) at LNGS.
